verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents a first-party bulk capability in its Email Verification API, which verifies addresses "in bulk". The templates API also mentions operating on "a list of templates". Bulk support is evidenced only for these narrow resources, not as a general batch-operation capability across items. Missing for 10: a documented bulk email-sending or batch endpoint, bulk operations across other resources (suppressions, domains, recipients), details on batch size limits and async job handling, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Verify a single email address or in bulk with MailerSend's Email Verification API.
Create, fetch, update, and delete single templates or a list of templates.
